'''Bescane''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] near [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], run by [[Galentro Heavy Works]]. A cool, temperate world, it was overpopulated and covered in factories, its natural environment destroyed.

==History==
By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the planet had become an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the system fell under control of the [[Pentastar Alignment]], and in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], under control of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. By the time of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Bescane was a fortress world of the Imperial Remnant. The system was [[Battle of Bescane|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />
